installation_questions.question: IGDB Client ID (optional)
installation_questions.description: Generate an ID and secret for IGDB (https://api-docs.igdb.com/#account-creation). IGDB provides titles, descriptions, cover art and related games.

installation_questions.question: IGDB Client Secret (optional)
installation_questions.description: The client secret from your IGDB application.

installation_questions.question: ScreenScraper username (optional)
installation_questions.description: Username for ScreenScraper.fr (https://www.screenscraper.fr). A free provider of titles, descriptions, cover art, screenshots and manuals.

installation_questions.question: RetroAchievements API key (optional)
installation_questions.description: Generate an API key from your RetroAchievements account settings (https://retroachievements.org/settings). Adds achievement progress tracking.

installation_questions.question: SteamGridDB API key (optional)
installation_questions.description: Generate an API key from your SteamGridDB profile preferences (https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api). Provides additional high-quality cover art.

installation_questions.question: Enable Hasheous metadata provider
installation_questions.description: Free, keyless hash-based matching that proxies IGDB titles, descriptions and cover art. Enabled by default so your first scan has metadata without any API keys.

installation_questions.question: Enable PlayMatch metadata provider
installation_questions.description: Free, community-driven hash-based matching service. No API key required.

installation_questions.question: Enable Flashpoint metadata
installation_questions.description: Metadata for 180,000+ flash and browser-based games. No API key required.

installation_questions.question: Enable HowLongToBeat metadata
installation_questions.description: Adds game completion times for 84,000+ games. No API key required.

installation_questions.question: Enable LaunchBox metadata
installation_questions.description: Community-driven metadata database. Requires running a LaunchBox metadata update (manual or scheduled) inside RomM before it can match games.

installation_questions.question: Rescan library on file changes
installation_questions.description: Automatically re-scan the library when filesystem changes are detected.

installation_questions.question: Enable scheduled library rescan
installation_questions.description: Periodically re-scan the library on a schedule.

installation_questions.question: Scheduled rescan cron expression
installation_questions.description: Cron schedule for library rescans, e.g. "0 3 * * *" for 3:00 AM daily. Only used when scheduled rescan is enabled.

installation_questions.question: Disable download endpoint authentication
installation_questions.description: Only required for Tinfoil/WebRcade integration. Lowers security, leave off unless you need it.
